need: Values over time or another ordered axis (months, hours, size buckets)
Counts or amounts per period, one series or several
guidance: `BarChartCard`; `stacked` when the series add up to a total

need: A running level, such as revenue against its target
Series compared point by point, such as growth against a benchmark
Samples in time with limits and events marked
Long category names, such as teams or product categories
A gain above zero and a loss below it
A total built up or bridged step by step, such as a year's profit month by month or revenue from last year to this by store
Signed changes by two categories, such as returns or profit by month and year, or by store and quarter
guidance: `ChangeGrid` in a `Card`, with each row's `total` worked out by the page

need: Each item's value at two points or against a benchmark, such as share of sales last year and this, or our mix against the market's
guidance: `SlopeChart` in a `Card`, with the few lines that matter `highlighted`

need: Ranked counts or amounts by category (a name, a bar and a figure)
guidance: `BarList`; give two lists one `max` to share a scale

need: Where a budget sits, a split of a whole, or losses against gains
Headline figures with their change
Many figures of equal weight, each with its change and recent run
A run of values beside a figure, in a tile, a strip or a table cell
A table column that should read as a bar chart
A table column of changes that should rank by eye, and a note on how to read the table
guidance: `ChangeBar` in the column's cell, `diverging` when it holds both signs; `DataTableFootnote` after `DataTableBody`

need: Figures against their targets, such as spend against budget
guidance: `TargetRows`, with neutral `bands` and a `status` per row

need: Where a value sits in its range, such as today's response time in its 30-day range
How far a level fell below its highest so far, over time, such as a fund's or a cash balance's drawdown
How many values fall in each range, such as response times or each trade's return, with the median or p95 marked
A long daily series, such as a price or an order value
Items sized by weight and coloured by change, such as sales by city
How two measures relate across many items, such as stores' size against growth
Items sorted into four groups by two signed changes, weighted by size, such as products by price change and sales change, sized by revenue
A gain or loss for every day, such as daily profit or a portfolio's daily change
Activity by day, by weekday and hour, or a status over time
Rows to sort and filter
A column that sorts on one click; a search and an "n of m" count
Stat tiles that pick a scope for the page
A share or a part of a whole, coloured as a gain or a loss
The colour scale under a `Treemap`
One part of a long page: rule, eyebrow, heading, lead, action
Label and value pairs, such as a record's fields
A command or file to copy, wrapped or scrolling
A labelled copy action, such as "Copy all" for a section
Data blocks side by side: charts, tables, a strip of figures
Separate square cards instead of the default ruled panels, or no lines at all, for a page or a part of one
A command, file or identifier inside prose
A signed figure (a gain, a loss, a change)
A time, with the viewer's own clock on hover
Tables inside narrow panels or on phones
guidance: `DataTable` suspends horizontal freezing below 40rem of table space; retain every field through scrolling, or compose essential columns and accessible record details in the page

need: Table filters that crowd a phone toolbar
guidance: Compose `Sheet` with `DataTableFacetedFilter`; useDataTable().isCompact follows the table container. Set DataTableRoot config.enableFilters explicitly when controls are conditional

need: Long ranked labels in a narrow panel
guidance: `BarList` wraps full names above their bars in narrow space; multi-series comparisons remain on `BarChartCard`

need: Heatmap cells on touch screens or with a keyboard
guidance: `CalendarHeatmap`, `WeekdayHeatmap` and `StatusHeatmap` use onCellClick with a visible readout; arrows navigate one tab entry. WeekdayHeatmap hours and weekdays choose the displayed domain
